blocks.heading: BambooHR cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price BambooHR against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (applicant tracking, career site and job boards, interview scheduling) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Small and mid-size teams that need a clean core HRIS as the employee system of record requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO
Side-by-side cost with Rippling on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Teams of 25 or fewer pay a list price floor, so effective PEPM is far above list price

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: ATS job-opening caps (5 / 25 / 50) make it a light hiring module, not a Greenhouse-class ATS

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: US-centric payroll/benefits bundle; not an enterprise HCM (Workday/UKG) replacement

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: No published free plan; packaging is quote-assisted even with list PEPM
